scope: Same153 already selected public synthetic English validation documents,250 values/45 policy-negatives. External author annotations, unknown training overlap. No public test or authored reserved predictions. Fixed three thresholds and twelve prompts across three models/two runtimes.
limits: Python full-text reference processing is not a native installed product backend
All text must fit512 framed tokens; truncation/over-budget input refuses the whole run
Pinned regex grapheme expansion is reference behavior, not assumed native ICU equivalence
MPS parameters and every output logits tensor must be on MPS with CPU fallback disabled; tokenization/decoding stay on CPU
Actual signed shipping-rule masks are reused without detector replication
Times include finite-output validation, no randomized paired isolation, physical power or competitor speed claim
Raw source/entity text is not persisted by this reference evaluator or published
No quality policy or production privacy acceptance
